Name: Color Valley
Author: Jessebot
TagLine: Adds more challenge to the game by recoloring a lot of tilesheets with a single color. Very configurable, includes 11 different colors and enable/disable tilesheets.
Description:
Imagine Stardew Valley without the beautiful stardew and the beautiful valley... like your favourite game without your favourite stuff. This mod is it, except that its not. Despite all that, you can still play Stardew Valley with the stuff you enjoy about it but more... difficult... is the term you're looking for ... and i guess, .... more beautiful as well (in its own way)... best recolor maybe?
I recommend you to use Data Layers to actually know what you are doing.
(tiny reminder to endorse the mod if you like it to support this mod **:)**)
**Features**

*   Recolors used map tilesheets with a single color (btw its still playable)

*   Configurable through [font=Courier New]config.json[/font]
- Choose from a range of supported colors (default: black)
        - Choose which tilesheets to disable (default: none)
        - Choose if world map also changes (default: true)
        - See [configuration instructions here](https://github.com/JessebotX/StardewMods/tree/master/.ContentPackMods/%5BCP%5D%20Color%20Valley#configure)

**Install**

1.  Install [SMAPI (2.11+)](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400)

2.  Install [Content Patcher (1.7+)](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915)

3.  **[Optional]** Install [Data Layers (latest version)](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1691)

4.  Download this mod, unzip/extract into [font=Courier New][/Stardew Valley/Mods](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Find_your_game_folder) [/font]
See [Player's Guide to using Mods](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide)

**Compatibility**

*   Works in singleplayer & multiplayer (changes are local so it only affects people who have it installed)

*   Not compatible with other recolors that load the same tilesheets
_Known issues:
_

*   Water isn't being recoloured, being worked on
